summary: Throne chairs are tall, carved, high-backed statement chairs for the couple, the guest of honor or a baby shower mom-to-be, rented singly or as a pair, often gold, silver or white with velvet. A typical king size is about 92 cm wide, 180 cm tall and 72 cm deep.
